states.description: Observations are temporal knowledge artifacts with revision history and content deduplication. The UI must accurately surface these invariants. Topic-key upsert (same topic_key → increment revisionCount, snapshot old version), content-hash deduplication (same SHA-256 within 15min → blocked, duplicates_prevented increments), and scope-based organization are backend behaviors visible through the UI.
states.precondition: An observation has been revised at least once via topic-key upsert

description: The Memory page (Observations tab, data-page-id='observations') in the qontinui-runner provides cross-session observation memory from past automation runs. It consists of two vertically stacked panels: MemoryHealthPanel (health metrics, 4 stat cards, Consolidate/Refresh controls, and a consolidation run log) and ObservationBrowser (full observation management with search, create, expand, and delete). Observations are typed artifacts — one of 6 types: decision, architecture, bugfix, pattern, learning, discovery — each with a distinct color. The backend uses PostgreSQL full-text search, content-hash deduplication (15-min window), and topic-key upsert semantics for revision history. Observations are also formatted into AI context (markdown summaries injected into session prompts). The health panel reflects the state of a memory consolidation system that groups observations into mental models and decays low-value entries.
